title: Qubrid AI RAG Entities
description: Schema definitions for Qubrid AI RAG API entities including knowledge bases, documents, RAG queries, and source references.

KnowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
KnowledgeBase.description: A knowledge base containing enterprise documents that are chunked, embedded, and indexed for retrieval-augmented generation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the knowledge base.

name.description: The display name of the knowledge base.

description.description: A description of the knowledge base and the type of data it contains.

embedding_model.description: The embedding model used to generate vector representations of document chunks.

chunk_size.description: The target size of each document chunk in tokens.

chunk_overlap.description: The number of tokens of overlap between consecutive document chunks.

document_count.description: The total number of documents in the knowledge base.

chunk_count.description: The total number of chunks across all documents.

status.description: The current status of the knowledge base.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the knowledge base was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the knowledge base was last updated.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A document uploaded to a knowledge base that is chunked and embedded for retrieval.

id.description: The unique identifier of the document.

name.description: The original filename of the uploaded document.

size_bytes.description: The size of the document file in bytes.

format.description: The file format of the document, such as pdf, txt, csv, or docx.

chunk_count.description: The number of chunks the document was split into.

status.description: The processing status of the document.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the document was uploaded.

RagQueryRequest.title: RAG Query Request
RagQueryRequest.description: A request to perform retrieval-augmented generation against a knowledge base.

knowledge_base_id.description: The identifier of the knowledge base to query against.

query.description: The natural language question or query to answer.

model.description: The identifier of the LLM to use for generating the response.

top_k.description: The number of most relevant document chunks to retrieve.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

include_sources.description: Whether to include source document references in the response.

RagQueryResponse.title: RAG Query Response
RagQueryResponse.description: The response from a RAG query containing the generated answer and source references.

answer.description: The generated response grounded in retrieved document context.

model.description: The model used to generate the response.

sources.description: Source document references used as context for the response.

usage.description: Token usage statistics for the RAG query.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt including retrieved context.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated response.

SourceReference.title: Source Reference
SourceReference.description: A reference to a source document chunk used as context in a RAG response.

document_id.description: The identifier of the source document.

document_name.description: The name of the source document.

chunk_text.description: The text content of the retrieved chunk.

relevance_score.description: The semantic similarity score between the query and this chunk.
